items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: We had one of the first commercial programs for Levy over WOR. And we'd have singers like Ada Ward, Clarence Townsend, Ernie Smith and like that.

ctx.x: We had one of the first commercial programs for Levy over WOR. And we'd have singers like Ada Ward, Clarence Townsend, Ernie Smith and like that.
But it was the Carroll Dickerson band.
